targets.authors: Duriez, B., Klimstra, T. A., Luyckx, K., Beyers, W., & Soenens, B.
targets.title: Right–Wing Authoritarianism: Protective Factor against Or Risk Factor for Depression?
targets.evidence_quote:
This is a Data Analytic Replication attempt on the Claim 4 claim from Duriez et al. (2012):

“high levels of right wing authoritarianism (RWA) predicted significant increases in depression over time (beta = .12, p < .05).“
targets.outcome_quote: The claim was not replicated as the effect of RWA on depression was non-significant in this replication study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit unsuccessful replication verdict. Secondary data are from a different sample, making this a replication rather than reanalysis of original data.
